evals.prompt: /superreview -- rewrote the payment processing flow, 12 files changed
evals.expected_output: Dispatches 5+ perspective agents (architect, code-quality, devils-advocate, operations, test-quality). Aggregation includes shared concerns, consensus, approach evaluation, correctness verification.
expectations: Dispatches 5 core perspective agents in one message
Aggregation includes approach evaluation with Sound/Concerns rating
Correctness verification prunes false positives before output

evals.expected_output: Fixes everything including nits. Re-review loop with no iteration cap. Continues until zero findings.
expectations: --auto all means every finding is FIX

evals.prompt: /superreview -- added rate limiting. spec exists in blueprints for this branch
evals.expected_output: Auto-detects spec via branch slug search. Spawns coherence reviewer alongside core 5.
expectations: Spawns coherence reviewer because $HAS_SPEC is true
Review stored via ct review create with --source linking to spec

evals.prompt: /superreview -- changed 8 Go files in the backend API
evals.expected_output: Detects Go as primary language. Spawns 5 core + Go language reviewer (6 agents).
expectations: Spawns language-specific reviewer with Go idiom checklist
Language reviewer checks error handling, goroutine leaks, interface bloat, context propagation

evals.prompt: /superreview -- architect flags coupling as High, code-quality considers it acceptable
evals.expected_output: Aggregation surfaces the disagreement in Perspective Disagreements section.
expectations: Shows perspective disagreement between architect and code-quality
Does not silently drop the finding or silently keep it
Approach Assessment section rates overall PR fitness

evals.expected_output: Still uses full perspective mode even for small diff. Only auto-fixes Critical severity.
expectations: Uses 5 perspective agents regardless of diff size
